decision.frozen_modify: All other mixed outcomes, retaining original criteria without tuning or per-community/per-bin oracle routing.

decision.exact_fraction_rule: Both recovered-bp/full-reference gains >=1/200 and no >=90% count decrease; no float tolerance or metric change.
decision.scope: One information/encoder bundle on two development communities. No isolated causal attention, optimality, product-default, feature-family or generalization claim.

interpretation.scope: Rounded retained MetaBAT2 reference is native whole-tool, with different eligibility; no matched-cutoff or universal superiority inference.
interpretation.main: Context is useful mixed development evidence. Parent recovery improves in both scopes and old-refiner recovery also improves on oral; final oral endpoint declines after a smaller fixed-E013 lift. No destructive post-versus-parent oral recovery loss, missing-depth cause, optimality or isolated attention effect is established.

next_decision.choice: One cached E019-learning + original E017 information-aware-grouping integration, keeping E013 and every original E017 default fixed.
next_decision.problem: E019 closes about 54.4% of the remaining E016-to-MetaBAT2 conservative E009 gap, but final oral recovery still trades off. A previously implemented original multi-information/core grouping bundle helped E009 and hurt oral with E016 learning; its interaction with improved E019 learning is untested.
next_decision.why_now: A one-off coherent integration tests whether the existing learning and grouping advances combine, at cached-run cost, before a much costlier pretrained sequence prior. No new threshold/loss/resolution series, baseline replay or expectation of additive gains.
next_decision.risks: E017 original already regressed oral. E019 oral learned-neighbor gain is small; the integration may fail. Both communities must use the same pipeline, full denominator and frozen rule. Do not pick E017/E019/E018 or refiners per dataset/bin.

alternatives.frozen_GLM_hybrid: Serious next information/architecture alternative with reviewed species-aware priors; defer extraction/new payloads now because E019 parent recovery improves in both scopes and an inexpensive downstream integration can change the next design. E003 failed criterion remains; it did not test current context/depth/learning and is no family veto.
alternatives.larger_transformer_or_marker_training: No direct evidence that capacity or safe cross-contig marker training is the limiting factor. Same-genome multicopy/partial/panel issues still make family-based labels unreliable.
alternatives.marker_selector_or_profile_grid: Reject another E009 acceptance/selector/resolution grid and per-bin oracle. Original E013 stays fixed; E018 permissive acceptance remains abandoned.
alternatives.immediate_skin_or_oral_mapping: Broader confirmation is needed before promotion and must not wait indefinitely for competitiveness. Keep current frozen skin unacquired while preparing this single integration and its unchanged additional-data protocol. Genuine oral depth is a separate input/cost experiment; current differences do not establish its causal benefit.

next_decision.decision_scope: Matched grouping-context integration on fixed E019 learning, not generalization or additive component proof.
next_decision.future_rule: Propose KEEP only if neither post full-reference R95 declines, at least one improves >=0.005 absolute and neither >=90% count falls; ABANDON if neither R95 nor either count improves, else MODIFY. Freeze before changed integration outcomes.
